purpose: Map autonomous governed budgeting to existing canonical capabilities before adding code.
authority: ELO Core capability; no parallel budgeting authority
status_rule: IMPLEMENTED means executable support exists; CONTRACT means defined but not independently executable; GAP means required capability is not yet sufficiently implemented.

capabilities.name: demand
capabilities.limitation: Demand is represented as governed inputs; no dedicated forecasting model is claimed.

capabilities.name: capacity
capabilities.limitation: Capacity is constraint validation, not automatic capacity discovery.

capabilities.name: cost
capabilities.limitation: Baseline formula is quantity × unit cost v1.0.

capabilities.name: pricing
capabilities.limitation: Price is an input; no autonomous market-pricing engine is claimed.

capabilities.name: margin
capabilities.limitation: Margin depends on complete revenue and cost evidence.

capabilities.name: forecast
capabilities.limitation: Dedicated demand/cost forecasting model remains a GAP.

capabilities.name: resource_planning
capabilities.owner: Core budgeting inputs + CapacityConstraint + Forge specialists
capabilities.evidence: BudgetInput classifications and capacity constraints; B04/B05
capabilities.limitation: Automatic resource allocation/execution remains governed and is not implied.

capabilities.name: risk
capabilities.limitation: Dedicated quantitative risk engine remains a GAP.

capabilities.name: quotation
capabilities.limitation: No independent quotation authority is created; quotation workflow still requires integration evidence.

capabilities.name: specialist_feedback
capabilities.evidence: specialist boundary, feedback registry and ELO-023
capabilities.limitation: MT-001 still requires real specialist evidence.

capabilities.name: budget_vs_actual
capabilities.limitation: Production-like actuals integration remains an external/runtime evidence gate.

capabilities.name: post_budget_learning
capabilities.evidence: existing learning governance; no direct Core mutation
capabilities.limitation: Promotion requires generalization, validation and Evolution Gate.

non_negotiable: Missing values remain GAP and trigger follow-up.
Provenance and tenant isolation are mandatory.
Contextual experience remains Forge unless generalized and promoted through governance.
Recommendation is not approval and approval is not execution.
No second Core, memory authority, scenario engine or autonomous executor is created for ELO-024.
